svg.title: How get_max_tokens picks max_tokens
svg.desc: Step one picks the requested value: max_completion_tokens if the request has it, else max_tokens, else the override max_new_tokens, else the max_new_tokens from the HF generation config, else nothing. Step two picks the cap: if --generation-config is a folder path, the server default is the cap; else the override max_new_tokens is the cap if given; else there is no cap. Step three takes the minimum of model_max_tokens, the requested value and the cap, leaving out missing values.

g.text: NONE VALUES ARE LEFT OUT · PLATFORM CAP IS NONE ON CUDA
